verdict.rationale: Base44 documents a dedicated 'bring your own agent' path. It connects your own AI coding agent to an app built in the app editor through its sandbox, with no local copy needed. GitHub two-way sync lets code written locally or in Base44 stay in step, which supports working alongside the built-in AI. The MCP server and agent skills add further agent-driven control. Missing for 10: detailed documentation of how the external agent and the built-in builder coexist during concurrent edits, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect my own coding agent to the project so it drives the builder alongside or instead of the built-in one

citations.quote: Bring your own AI coding agent, or your own scripts, to a Base44 app by connecting to its sandbox.
Connect your own AI coding agent to an app you built in the app editor, with no local copy of the code
Connect your app to GitHub to write code in your local development environment or in Base44 and keep them in sync with each other.
The Base44 MCP server exposes your Base44 account to any MCP-compatible AI assistant.
